blocks.text: Long links or words can force a box wider than its screen. overflow-wrap lets a long piece of text break when needed.
Use the runnable HTML examples here, then resize a local browser page or its device preview. The CSS examples are inside each small page, so no framework is required.
Read the code step by step

items: `overflow-wrap: anywhere` allows a long unbroken word to wrap rather than widening the whole layout.

blocks.text: The long word wraps inside the narrow card instead of pushing the layout sideways.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Hiding overflow can hide important words. Prefer a wrapping rule when the text needs to be read.
